test.create_query: CREATE TABLE read_in_order_wide (key String, payload UInt64, c1 String, c2 String, c3 String, c4 String, c5 String, c6 String, c7 String, c8 String, c9 String, c10 String, c11 String, c12 String, c13 String, c14 String, c15 String, c16 String, c17 String, c18 String, c19 String, c20 String) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY intDiv(payload, 5000000) ORDER BY key AS SELECT concat('k/', toString(number % 100000), '/v') AS key, number AS payload, concat('c1-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c1, concat('c2-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c2, concat('c3-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c3, concat('c4-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c4, concat('c5-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c5, concat('c6-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c6, concat('c7-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c7, concat('c8-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c8, concat('c9-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c9, concat('c10-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c10, concat('c11-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c11, concat('c12-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c12, concat('c13-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c13, concat('c14-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c14, concat('c15-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c15, concat('c16-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c16, concat('c17-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c17, concat('c18-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c18, concat('c19-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c19, concat('c20-', toString(number % 1000)) AS c20 FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
test.query: SELECT * FROM read_in_order_wide ORDER BY key FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM read_in_order_wide WHERE key LIKE '%/v' ORDER BY key FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM read_in_order_wide ORDER BY key DESC FORMAT Null
